findings.text: instrumentation_delta is recorded but never asserted zero, so the fragment's claim that the main and saddle-geometry probes reproduce their ordinary zero-injection residual bit for bit rests on a field a reader must compare rather than a guard that fails; the same applies to attribute.py:262, and the CPU and geometry receipts do carry 0.0 today.
